input.reason: Planning cannot proceed because all required prerequisites for a valid protocol proposal are absent. No registered checks are available, and the information needed to construct a prospective networking pilot is missing: (1) the exact configuration parameters for "configuration A" are unspecified (topology, packet size, load, protocol, queue discipline, etc.); (2) the delay direction and network conditions are unknown; (3) no versioned/hashed input artifact or dataset is available (confirmed by previous feedback: "The authors dataset is absent; no archived artifact or measurement input is available."); (4) the original hypothesis and success criterion (e.g., tolerance around 12 ms) are not supplied; (5) no execution specification identity (e.g., emulated-netem-v1 or real-world-iperf-v1 configuration block) with seeds, trial counts, or stopping rules is provided.
